message.content:
This editorial illustration is a vertical rectangular collage featuring a stylized bust-length portrait of a man in military attire against a red and white background. The image is constructed from overlapping fragments of paper, including newsprint, alphabet sequences, and photographs.

The central figure wears a peaked cap and a high-collared uniform. His face and clothing are formed by small, jagged scraps of paper in various colors, primarily white, gray, brown, and blue, often containing printed letters or words. His facial features are defined by the placement of darker paper fragments for his eyes, nose, and mouth. The peaked cap is primarily black with white letter patterns and a yellow circular emblem at the front.

In the upper-left, the white word "TEMPO" is partially visible. In the lower-left, text in white and red boxes reads: "EDISI KHUSUS HARI KEMERDEKAAN," "Abdul Haris Nasution," and "Pelopor Dua Wajah Tentara." The background consists of vibrant red paper textured with white letterforms. A barcode and QR code are in the bottom right corner near text stating "18-24 AGUSTUS 2025" and "RP 70.000." Individual words like "UNTUK" and "MARET" are legible among the collage pieces.
